name: Korg KRONOS
description: Korg KRONOS, KRONOS 2 and KRONOS 3: every setting of an HD-1 program by SysEx parameter change, read back from the current program.

sources.title: KRONOS MIDI Implementation: HD-1 Program, Version 1.01 (Jan 7, 2015), object version 5
sources.notes: Rows read by tools/profiles/korg/read-kronos-table.mjs from Prog_HD-1.txt (sha256 b121554c53040e283afba4616632c127df5396c54bf2a0fc6fe55fe1c332c52c) in KRONOS_MIDIimp.zip of 2025-07-24, https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/988/5480/. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.

Every row of Prog_HD-1.txt with a parameter id is a parameter, named by its group and its name as printed, and sent by Parameter Change (function 43): F0 42 3g 68 43 TYP SOC SUB PID IDX and the value as 21 bits, two's complement, high byte first (*4). Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The rows of KARMA… go by KARMA Parameter Change (function 6D), the same message as Parameter Change under another code. The table prints no message per row. Per group, the rows whose ids Parameter Change also takes for another row, and so cannot go by it: KARMA Common, 24 of 527 (0 0 0 0 0 is KARMA Common Tempo and Common Oscillator Mode); KARMA Module, 13 of 219 (1 0 0 0 0 is KARMA Module GE Number and Common LFO Waveform). A group goes by one message: one with such rows cannot go by Parameter Change, and one with none goes by 6D on the message's name alone. A reading, not tried on an instrument.

The rows of Drum Track… go by Drum Track Parameter Change (function 6E), the same message as Parameter Change under another code. The table prints no message per row. Per group, the rows whose ids Parameter Change also takes for another row, and so cannot go by it: Drum Track Common, 11 of 11 (0 0 0 1 0 is Drum Track Common Pattern Number and Common Assign Mode); Drum Track, 0 of 22. A group goes by one message: one with such rows cannot go by Parameter Change, and one with none goes by 6E on the message's name alone. A reading, not tried on an instrument.

An HD-1 program only: the KRONOS takes program parameters in Program mode ("Which parameters are currently available for editing depends on the instrument's mode"), and a program of an EXi bank is laid out in Prog_EXi_Common.txt and Prog_EXi.txt, not here. The effects' own parameters, which depend on the effect type (Effect.txt), are not here either.

A range whose first value is the larger (9D~63) is two's complement over its bytes, -99~+99. A choice is a row naming both of two values, or a row whose ends are the ends of the voice model's AMS source list (Off~Tempo, sources 0~48). The value column is 19 characters wide; a name it cuts short keeps its cut, with an ellipsis. Other value names are in each parameter's description.
A parameter id above 126 takes the message's second form, 7F PIDH PIDL, which the archive calls deprecated and says the instrument still receives.

"Amount A" as "Offset Amount": the AMS Mixer prints "Amount A" twice, for parameter 2 (-99~+99) and parameter 10 (-199~+199); the voice model's list (SysExParams/VoiceModels/HD-1.txt) calls parameter 10 "Offset: Amount", beside "Offset: Offset".
629 rows with an id print a fixed value (`10(fixed)`, `00(fixed)`: Insert Effect1 Channel; Insert Effect2 Channel; Insert Effect3 Channel; …) and are not settings.

Left out: 23 settings (Insert Effect1 Chain Switch; Insert Effect1 Chain To; Insert Effect2 Chain Switch; Insert Effect2 Chain To; Insert Effect3 Chain Switch; Insert Effect3 Chain To; …): shares its parameter id with Chain To (`* Chain To`), and the archive does not say which value of it turns the chain off.

Left out: 8 settings (KARMA Common (RT Param.1) Param.Assign; KARMA Common (RT Param.2) Param.Assign; KARMA Common (RT Param.3) Param.Assign; KARMA Common (RT Param.4) Param.Assign; KARMA Common (RT Param.5) Param.Assign; KARMA Common (RT Param.6) Param.Assign; …): no range printed (data(hex) is blank).
Left out: 1 setting (KARMA Module Start Seed): a 32-bit value in four bytes with an id each (`* Big Endian`), wider than a 21-bit parameter change.

Left out: 33 settings (Tone Adjust Knob1 Assign; Tone Adjust Knob2 Assign; Tone Adjust Knob3 Assign; Tone Adjust Knob4 Assign; Tone Adjust Knob5 Assign; Tone Adjust Knob6 Assign; …): its parameter change takes SUB from the value (`SUB = (Assign >> 7) & 0x01, Value = Assign & 0x7f`), which one message template cannot.

Left out: 16 settings (OSC1 Trigger Zone1 MS Bank UUID; OSC1 Trigger Zone2 MS Bank UUID; OSC1 Trigger Zone3 MS Bank UUID; OSC1 Trigger Zone4 MS Bank UUID; OSC1 Trigger Zone5 MS Bank UUID; OSC1 Trigger Zone6 MS Bank UUID; …): a 16-byte UUID, sent by Parameter Change (binary), function 44.

Pull: Current Object Dump Request (function 74) for object 00, the program, answered by a Current Object Dump (function 75) carrying object version 5 and 3706 bytes in Korg's 8-in-7 packing (*3: 4236 bytes). 1476 parameters are read back at their rows' offsets and bits. A program of an EXi bank is laid out otherwise, and its dump is not this length, so it does not match.

Sent and not read back: 186 settings (Effect LFO1 BPM; Effect LFO2 BPM; Drum Track Common Pattern Number; KARMA Common Tempo; KARMA Common Switch1 Name ID; KARMA Common Switch2 Name ID; …): a value over two bytes: the archive marks only the KARMA Start Seed's bytes `Big Endian` and does not say the order of the others.

Sent and not read back: 128 settings (KARMA Common (Note Map) C-1; KARMA Common (Note Map) C#-1; KARMA Common (Note Map) D-1; KARMA Common (Note Map) D#-1; KARMA Common (Note Map) E-1; KARMA Common (Note Map) F-1; …): a value the dump may hold as FF, which the parameter does not offer.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.

Identity: the Device Inquiry reply (KRONOS_MIDI_Implementation.pdf) is printed F0 7E 0g 06 02 42 68 00 mm 00 vv ww xx 00 F7. Its 7th to 8th bytes, 68 00, are checked as printed, where the universal reply puts the family code; its 9th byte, mm, is one per model and is not checked: KRONOS/KRONOS2 61Keys 05H, KRONOS/KRONOS2 73Keys 0EH, KRONOS/KRONOS2 88Keys 17H, KRONOS3 61Keys 1DH, KRONOS3 73Keys 26H, KRONOS3 88Keys 2FH.
No preset recall yet: the implementation's Bank Select footnote is not read.
